svg.aria-label: Rows on one axis of the values 0 to 15 and beyond: after slot 3 r6 may hold any value; slot 10 splits the walk, with 8 and up jumping to the exit and 0 to 7 falling through; on the fall-through side the range is 0 to 7 and the tnum ends in three unknown bits; after the shift the offsets 0 to 56 stay inside the 64-byte value, since 56 + 8 = 64.
svg.title: One test narrows the range of r6, on one axis
svg.text: slots 11 to 13: r6 <<= 3; r0 += r6; read
